title: Stone SMP
description: a public smp for anyone to join, this server gets streamed on tiktok (user: 4vtwmc).
body: Stone SMP is a fun and welcoming Minecraft server built around the pure vanilla experience, keeping the game feeling authentic while adding quality-of-life features like RTP (random teleportation), homes, and TPA (teleport player) to make exploration and settling in easier. The community is friendly and abuse-free, ensuring a safe and enjoyable environment for all players.
